_comment: The sample values that scripts/check-private-data.mjs allows (ST-M006-016). Every list is a list of groups, and every group says why its values are here. Add a new sample value here and to "Sample data" in CONTRIBUTING.md in the same change. Never add a real name, address or path: replace it by a sample value.

ipv4._comment: The unspecified address and the broadcast address. Every 127.x.x.x address is allowed without being listed.
Network constants: the private (RFC 1918), link-local and loopback ranges that code and documentation name.
Fixture addresses in the private ranges, for computers on the same network.
A fixture address for a second network of one computer: a virtual adapter next to its local network.
Fixture addresses in the documentation ranges (RFC 5737), for peers on the internet.
Not an address: the assembly version in apps/support-agent/cretlink-support.manifest.
Not an address: a spelling with leading zeros that the check of a relay's host name must refuse (crates/relay/src/ticket.rs).

accounts._comment: Sample accounts: Ann, Sam, a technician, a customer and J. Doe. An account with a space in its name, such as Ann Lee, counts by its first word.
The accounts of the GitHub-hosted runners, which build paths and logs show.
Placeholders for an account in documentation, and the parent folder in tests that reject path traversal.
One-letter accounts in tests of path handling.

computerNames._comment: Names of the form Windows generates: DESKTOP- or LAPTOP- and seven or eight characters. None so far: the sample computers have names such as TECH-LAPTOP, which the rule does not match.

emailDomains._comment: The no-reply addresses of GitHub, which commits use.

emailExceptions._comment: Not an address: the file name of an icon at double resolution.
Not a person: the no-reply address in the Co-Authored-By trailer of commits written with an AI assistant, which published commits carry.
